Type: dresser
Name: Pinzon Walthum Dresser
Colors: Java
Materials: Wood
Beautiful dresser has 6 drawers with French dovetail fronts and English backs on double wood glides Solid rubberwood and ash veneer with dark Java finish; brushed aluminum handles 75-pound capacity; drawers are 27 inches long by 14-1/4 inches deep by 6-1/4 inches high Coordinates with the Pinzon Walthum Bedroom Furniture Collection Measures 33-1/4 inches high by 64 inches wide by 20 inches deep
